question: Should OpenClaw add an additive multi-emoji acknowledgment contract, and if so should initial selection be deterministic, random, rule-based, or model-driven?
rationale: The current config and channel APIs do not establish selection semantics, while each option changes latency, predictability, compatibility, and configuration complexity.

options.title: Add local strategy
options.body: Keep ackReaction compatible and add an optional emoji list with a deterministic, round-robin, or random local selector that performs no model call.

options.title: Add model-driven selection
options.body: Introduce a pre-ack model or agent hook, accepting additional latency, cost, and failure behavior before acknowledgment appears.

options.title: Keep fixed reactions
options.body: Retain static global, channel, and account-level configuration and close the contextual-selection direction as unnecessary complexity.

recommendation.title: Add local strategy
recommendation.body: Keep ackReaction compatible and add an optional emoji list with a deterministic, round-robin, or random local selector that performs no model call.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest existing product-direction signal in the issue discussion and can decide whether the additional config and agent behavior belong in core.
